name: NexDrop
description:
NexDrop — Private. Direct. Fast.

NexDrop is a native Android file-sharing app designed to transfer files directly between compatible Android devices over a reachable local Wi-Fi or hotspot connection. Share photos, videos, documents, APKs and other supported files through a dedicated Android transfer experience built around transfer control, progress monitoring and file integrity verification.

PRIVATE. DIRECT. FAST.

NexDrop uses its native NDT1 TCP transfer engine for direct local device-to-device transfers. Files are transferred over the local connection rather than being uploaded to a cloud file-storage service.

Designed for Practical File Sharing

Whether you are sending a large video, sharing study documents, transferring an APK or moving several files together, NexDrop provides a dedicated Android workflow for managing transfers and checking their completion status.

Local Connection Requirements

For native local transfers, connect both Android devices to a reachable shared Wi-Fi network or a hotspot arrangement that allows them to communicate. Actual transfer speed depends on the devices, Wi-Fi band, signal quality, file sizes and network conditions.

NexDrop does not promise a fixed transfer speed for every device or network.

Privacy-Focused by Design

NexDrop is designed for direct local transfers rather than cloud file-storage uploads. Review Android permissions and the receiving device's transfer request before sharing files.
shortDescription: Fast, private Android file sharing with direct local transfer and file verification.
features: Direct Android-to-Android Transfer — Share files directly over a local Wi-Fi or hotspot connection.
Large File Sharing — Transfer large videos, documents, APKs and other files.
Multi-File Transfer Queue — Select, organize and send multiple files in sequence.
Smart File Previews — Preview supported images, videos, PDFs and APK details before sending.
Pause & Resume Transfers — Pause active transfers and resume supported interrupted transfers.
Automatic Retry & Recovery — Retry failed transfers and recover supported interrupted sessions.
SHA-256 File Verification — Verify file integrity after transfer.
Live Transfer Monitoring — View transfer progress, speed and completion status.
Transfer History Management — Review previous transfers and access available file actions.
Native NDT1 TCP Engine — Dedicated Android transfer technology designed for efficient local file sharing.
releaseNotes: Fixed Open: received files now open directly from the Transfer Complete screen and from transfer History with the correct app for each file type.
Fixed Save: the Save action opens Android's system folder picker and saves any received file as a verified size-complete copy.
Fixed Install: received APK files open Android's package installer with the proper permission flow, so apps can be installed directly.
Added Share: share any received file straight to other apps from both the receive screen and transfer History.
Per-file actions in transfer History: every record offers Open, Save, Share and Install for its own file.
Multi-file receive sessions: each received file gets its own individual Open, Save, Share and Install actions.
Duplicate filename protection: saving a file with an existing name adds a numbered suffix instead of overwriting the first file.

privacyTech.dataCollection: Files and text are transferred directly between paired devices and are not uploaded to cloud file storage. Transfer history is stored locally on the device and is never uploaded.
privacyTech.tracking: Not verified — AppMintly has not audited the app for trackers.
privacyTech.offlineSupport: Native device-to-device transfers run over local Wi-Fi without internet; the web app keeps an offline shell, with transfers needing a connection or the manual QR fallback.
privacyTech.storage: Transfer history is stored locally on the device in a private file bounded to the last 100 records.
privacyTech.installationType: Native Android app + installable web app (PWA)
privacyTech.notes: The native Android engine transfers over local Wi-Fi with HMAC-SHA256-authenticated pairing sessions; the separate NexDrop web app adds encrypted (DTLS + AES-256-GCM) WebRTC transfers. Neither path uploads file contents to cloud storage.

name: BillCraft
description:
BillCraft — Create. Calculate. Share.

BillCraft is a privacy-first document creation tool designed to help freelancers, independent professionals and small business owners create polished business documents without unnecessary complexity.

Create invoices, quotations, receipts and estimates using professionally designed templates. Calculate GST, discounts and totals, convert amounts into words, and prepare documents for sharing or PDF export.

Key Features:

1. Professional Invoice Creator
2. Quotation & Estimate Generator
3. Receipt Creation
4. Premium Document Templates
5. GST Calculator — CGST, SGST & IGST
6. Discount & Savings Calculator
7. Amount in Words
8. PDF Export
9. UPI QR Support
10. Local-First Privacy Workflow

Target audience: Freelancers, independent professionals, small business owners, consultants and service providers.

BillCraft works entirely on your device — no account, no cloud document storage, no backend server. Your business documents stay yours. PDF export and UPI QR codes are generated locally in your browser.

name: CineFlow
description:
CineFlow — Private · Cinema · Control

CineFlow is a private, device-first local video player built for people who want full control over their own media.

Open compatible local video files, build playlists, resume playback where you left off, and use an advanced subtitle studio with SRT and WebVTT support, timing offset and styling controls. A browser diagnostics screen shows which formats your device can actually decode.

Key Features:

1. Local Video Playback
2. Multi-File Selection & Queue
3. Video Library with Search
4. Recent Playback History
5. Resume Playback
6. Playlist Management
7. Favorites
8. SRT & VTT Subtitle Support
9. Subtitle Timing Offset & Styling
10. Playback Diagnostics
11. Device-to-Device Transfer
12. Installable PWA with Offline Shell

Target audience: People who store videos on their own devices and want a private, local-first player.

CineFlow works entirely on your device. Playback history, playlists, favorites, subtitles and settings are stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB) — video files are never uploaded, and no account or cloud storage is involved. Playback compatibility depends on your device, browser, codec and file format.

Your videos. Your device. Your control.
shortDescription: Play local videos privately with playlists, subtitles and playback resume — your media stays on your device.
features: Local Video Playback — Open and play compatible video files directly from your device (H.264/MP4 and VP9/WebM verified in release testing).
Multi-File Selection & Queue — Select several videos at once and manage the playback queue.
Video Library — Imported videos appear with duration, size, last-played date and progress in a searchable library.
Video Search — Filter your library instantly by name.
Recent Playback History — Every played video is recorded locally and can be resumed or removed.
Resume Playback — Continue where you left off; saved positions are restored across sessions.
Playlist Management — Create, rename and organize playlists of video sets.
Favorites — Mark videos as favorites and view them in a dedicated tab.
SRT & VTT Subtitle Support — Load local SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) files with on-screen cues.
Subtitle Timing Offset & Styling — Adjust audio-sync offset and choose font, size, colour and placement presets.
Playback Diagnostics — A dedicated screen probes your browser's live decoder and codec support.
Device-to-Device Transfer — Optional WebRTC transfer sends files directly between your own devices with manual pairing codes; no server involved.
Installable PWA with Offline Shell — Install as an app; the interface loads offline via a precached service-worker shell.
Local-First Storage — History, playlists, favorites, subtitles and settings stay in your browser's IndexedDB; video files never leave your device.
